about_bio: Hi, I'm Anthony! I'm a magician and mentalist (mind reader) who loves to travel. I've performed for over 2,000 corporate and private events in every major US city, as well as Africa, India, Asia, Europe, and Australia. I've always loved to entertain people; I've been performing on stage for 25 years, and over 400 of my past clients have left 5 star reviews on Google. I've appeared in commercials, print advertisements, television shows, and movies; but nothing compares to performing magic and mentalism for a live audience. I love the thrill of entertaining people, and I've been fortunate enough to be able to entertain for a living. From celebrities to CEOs, I can bring a laugh and a smile to anyone. My wit, charm, and clean humor give a personal moment of astonishment to every guest. I look forward to giving your event a unique and magical touch! As for my 'why', it's 100% my daughter. She's the light of my life!

faq.question: How can I check your availability?
faq.answer: If you're in the early stages of planning your party or event, the easiest and fastest way to check my availability is to simply give me a call. I'm also happy to chat with you through email or text, but I tend to lean towards good old-fashioned phone calls because a lot more communication can happen in a few short minutes. If your party or event is in less than a month, reach out immediately. Although my calendar gets decently filled up a couple of months in advance, the month can get pretty crazy with last-minute bookings to fill in the cracks. But unless I'm on stage or performing at the time, I'll always answer my phone.

faq.question: What can I expect when hiring?
faq.answer: There's a reason I have so many 5-star reviews... I set the bar pretty high for myself. First and foremost, when you first reach out to me to book, I'll get your contract sent over that same day (unless I'm out of town for a performance). I answer your questions or emails promptly. I know how hard it can be planning an upscale event, and the last thing you need is to be hunting down a magician for a copy of liability insurance! Fast-forward to the long-awaited day of your event. You can bet your bottom dollar that I'll be outside waiting in my car at least 20 minutes early (in case you need me to start sooner than expected). I'll enter your event well-dressed and well-groomed, with a smile on my face, ready to start captivating your party guests with magic and mentalism. If you've booked my strolling magic and mentalism, I'll be working my way around the party, entertaining small groups of people when they have a break in conversation. You can also expect me to be flexible to a certain extent. If you're running 15 minutes behind or your dinner was served a little late, I'm happy to pause for a bit to accommodate your schedule, providing I don't have another event right after yours. So yeah, I try to set the bar high so my clients know they're working with the best!
